title: Recursive Agent Harnesses
abstract_en: Recursive language models (RLMs) showed that recursion over model calls is an effective strategy for long-context reasoning, and production coding agents have begun to write code that spawns subagents at scale, most recently in Anthropic's dynamic workflows. We name and study the pattern between these two lines of work, where the recursive unit is a full agent harness with filesystem tools, code execution, and planning rather than a model call with no tools. We call this the Recursive Agent Harness (RAH) and frame it as harness recursion, the code-first extension to the model recursion of RLMs. A parent agent generates and runs an executable script that spawns subagent harnesses in parallel for fine-grained workloads and uses structured function calls for small subtasks. We provide a controlled evaluation on long-context reasoning. With the backbone held fixed at GPT-5 to match the published Codex and RLM baselines, RAH improves the Codex coding-agent baseline from 71.75% to 81.36% on Oolong-Synthetic (199 samples, 13 context-length buckets up to 4M tokens), a gain attributable to the harness rather than the model. With a stronger backbone, Claude Sonnet 4.5, the same design reaches 89.77%.
abstract_zh: 本文提出并研究 Recursive Agent Harness（RAH），一种介于 Recursive Language Models（RLMs）与生产级 coding agents 动态工作流之间的模式。与 RLMs 仅递归调用无工具模型不同，RAH 将递归单元扩展为完整的 agent harness，包含文件系统工具、代码执行与规划能力。父 agent 会生成并运行可执行脚本，并行启动多个 subagent harness 来处理细粒度任务，同时用结构化函数调用完成小型子任务。作者在长上下文推理任务上进行受控评测：在固定 GPT-5 作为 backbone、对齐已发表的 Codex 与 RLM baselines 时，RAH 在 Oolong-Synthetic（199 个样本，13 个上下文长度分桶，最高 4M tokens）上将 Codex coding-agent baseline 从 71.75% 提升到 81.36%，说明收益主要来自 harness 设计而非模型本身。使用更强的 Claude Sonnet 4.5 backbone 时，同一设计达到 89.77%。
key_points_zh: 提出 Recursive Agent Harness（RAH）：将 RLMs 的“模型调用递归”扩展为“完整 agent harness 递归”，每个递归单元具备工具、代码执行和规划能力。
RAH 采用父 agent 生成并执行脚本的方式，并行派生多个 subagent harness，用于处理长上下文中的细粒度工作负载。
方法同时结合结构化函数调用（structured function calls），用于解决较小的子任务，形成多粒度任务分解机制。
在 Oolong-Synthetic 长上下文推理基准上，固定 GPT-5 backbone 时，RAH 将 Codex coding-agent baseline 从 71.75% 提升到 81.36%。
使用 Claude Sonnet 4.5 作为更强 backbone 时，RAH 达到 89.77%，显示该 harness 设计可随模型能力进一步放大收益。

llm_assessment.comment: Highly relevant harness-level work that formalizes recursive subagent orchestration with strong implications for scalable agent runtimes.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项高度相关的智能体框架研究，形式化了递归子智能体编排，并对可扩展运行时具有重要意义。
